sections.heading: D — Accuracy notes and source flags: the four-part driver examination
sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: the four-part driver examination
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical guide page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The written-test size on this page agrees with the question count and passing standard stated on the guide introduction page used in part A [A01].
The road sign test is described only by its purpose; the guide gives no item count or pass mark for it, so none is stated [A02] (verify MO-EXAM-D-SIGNTEST).
The driving test grade is described only as a deduction from a point budget with a limit; the guide gives no per-error point values, so none are stated [A04].
The parking dimensions use a typographic inch mark in the extracted text; it was read as inches from the curb, matching the hill-parking item on the same page.
The Highway Patrol website address and testing center locations are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The Missouri Driver Guide prints a single edition line on its front cover (Revised August 2026); its table-of-contents note says law and policy changes may make parts out of date and points to the website for the current version, with no sign in the selected pages of more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: The Missouri Driver Guide (physical page 21) describes the road sign test only as checking sign recognition and understanding; its number of items, format and passing mark are not stated and need an official Department of Revenue or Highway Patrol source before any value is taught.
